messages:
alex: FYI customer escalated. Intermittent 502s + high p99 (~3s) hitting /v1/chat when they pin to rwd-7b-v1-canary. Also seeing sporadic auth failures and a billing webhook error. Last request id they reported: req_0a1b2c3d4e. Need repro steps and quick mitigation (pin to stable?).

leila: thanks — can you paste the exact curl they used and the x-request-id header? also need a debug bundle from their infra and our proxy/runtime logs for the timeframe around req_0a1b2c3d4e.

alex: curl they used (sanitized):
```
curl -v \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d4e" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-7b-v1-canary","input":"Hello world"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
```

kevin: fyi from runtime side I see a cluster of 502s around that epoch with concurrent KV cache misses and goroutine backpressure spikes. attaching small tail of runtime log for the window (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-15T12:01:02Z] req=req_0a1b2c4a svc=runtime lvl=warn msg="kv-cache miss" model=rwd-7b-v1-canary
[2026-03-15T12:01:03Z] req=req_0a1b2c3d4e svc=runtime lvl=error msg="upstream grpc error: code=Unavailable" proto=attn
[2026-03-15T12:01:04Z] req=req_0a1b2c3d4e svc=proxy lvl=error msg="502 from runtime" route=/v1/chat
```

billing-bot: alert: webhook delivery failed for acct-123 at 2026-03-15T12:00:58 (status=401). Payload was billing/invoice.created -> customer webhook returned 401. Might be separate but worth noting the time overlap.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for rwd-7b-v1-canary -> 10% traffic at 2026-03-15T12:00Z (initiated by maya).

maya: possible the canary's quantization/kernel selection introduced occasional transient failures under certain seq-lens. Suggest we temporarily pin the customer to rwd-7b-v1-stable and set a fallback that routes to stable on 5xx. Also want a reproducible curl + their sample prompt length distribution.

leila: agreed. alex — can you ask the customer to run our debug bundle collector with their request id and attach the tarball? Command to give them: 
```
./collect-debug-bundle.sh --req req_0a1b2c3d4e --include-proxy --include-runtime --anon --out debug-req_0a1b2c3d4e.tgz
```

alex: sent the command and the simplified curl. asked them to include a short repro script (3 runs) showing the intermittent 502s and to share timing for each request. asked them to confirm whether they were using any custom header signing that might affect billing webhook auth.

kevin: in parallel I'll instrument an additional temp metric for kv-cache-miss-rate and bump canary retry timeout to see if we reduce 502 surface. If we reproduce locally I'll try rolling the canary back.

maya: if customer agrees to pin, support can set their org config to pin to `rwd-7b-v1-stable` and enable `fallback=stable-on-5xx` for 24h. That will unblock them fast.

alex: customer agreed to pin to stable while we debug. applied temporary pin and notified them. they will upload debug bundle within the hour. I'll attach once received.

leila: perfect. once we have the bundle we'll correlate proxy+runtime logs with their timeline (req_0a1b2c3d4e) and determine if the canary-specific kernel path is root cause. if repro, plan: rollback canary -> run QA with quantization test harness -> reintroduce with narrower traffic % and additional telemetry.

alex: thanks all — I'll update thread with bundle and any curl traces they provide. :thumbsup:
